text: The vet is excellent and doesn't hold back any knowledge. She answers all questions and explains things clearly. The prices are reasonable for both vaccines and treatments. She even offers free consultations sometimes. All my cats are treated by her. She's great... P.S. Closed every Thursday.
The doctor is very skilled and gives excellent advice. They respond to messages very quickly! The treatment cost is not expensive at all. Highly recommend!
